types.name: Attestation
docs: Payload plus aggregate Schnorr signature.

types.name: AttestationPayload
docs: Signed oracle attestation payload.

types.name: CoalitionKey
docs: Affine coalition key `Σ X_i = (x, y)`, big-endian: an untrusted verification input.
Supplying it lets the verifier check its Jacobian sum against the key instead of normalizing
the sum with a field inversion (see [`CoalitionAccumulator::compressed_pubkey_with_key`]).
It is a property of the point, not of the verifier's arithmetic: any secp256k1 library
computes it as the plain sum of the signers' public keys, in any order.
Not part of the signed message or the cross-VM [`crate::Attestation`]; carry it next to the
attestation, e.g. in Solana instruction data.

fields.name: coalition_key_a
docs: Affine sum of `attestation_a`'s signer keys. A verification input, not evidence: it is
left out of [`Evidence::hash`], so the case PDA derives from the attestations alone.

fields.name: coalition_key_b
docs: Affine sum of `attestation_b`'s signer keys; see `coalition_key_a`.

types.name: CommittedNoncePair
docs: The nonce pair committed for one slot, as affine coordinates.
Points travel uncompressed so the program never pays for a field square root; both are
re-checked on-curve during equation verification.

types.name: Delegate
docs: Owner-scoped delegate authorization. `max_data_requests` is enforced by the gateway at
admission, not on chain.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: The node was tombstoned; its share stays in the epoch residual.

types.name: EpochState
docs: One epoch of the reward pool: its window, pinned ticket threshold, swept income and the
per-node participation counters fed by tickets.
Counters are keyed by an epoch-local roster of `Node` PDAs rather than by registry position,
because registry positions move between versions (swap-remove) while one epoch spans several.
The roster fills lazily as tickets name nodes for the first time.
PDA: `[SEED_PREFIX, epoch.to_le_bytes()]`. Layout has no implicit padding.

fields.name: start
docs: Inclusive window start (unix seconds). Equals the previous epoch's `end`.

fields.name: end
docs: Exclusive window end (unix seconds).

fields.name: ticket_grace
docs: Snapshot of `ticket_grace_seconds` at creation.

fields.name: tau
docs: A round is a ticket when the big-endian `u64` prefix of its ticket hash is below this.

fields.name: pool
docs: USDC swept into this epoch while it was open.

fields.name: paid
docs: Sum of payouts credited to nodes.

fields.name: weight_total
docs: `Σ weight(slot)`, frozen at finalization.

fields.name: sum_signed
docs: `Σ signed`, maintained per ticket.

fields.name: sum_selected
docs: `Σ selected`, maintained per ticket.

fields.name: min_availability_bps
docs: Snapshot: availability floor relative to the network inclusion rate, in bps.

fields.name: min_samples
docs: Snapshot: samples below which the availability floor does not apply.

fields.name: weighted_count
docs: Roster slots with non-zero weight, frozen at finalization.

fields.name: credited_count
docs: Weighted slots already processed by `credit_epoch_rewards`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives this account's rent when the epoch is closed.

fields.name: credited
docs: Bitmap over roster slots already credited.

fields.name: min_signers
docs: Snapshot of the admission quorum floor for rounds counted in this epoch.

fields.name: coalition_key_a
docs: Affine sum of `attestation_a`'s signer keys. A verification input, not evidence: it is
left out of [`Evidence::hash`], so the case PDA derives from the attestations alone.

fields.name: coalition_key_b
docs: Affine sum of `attestation_b`'s signer keys; see `coalition_key_a`.

types.name: FeedValueKind
docs: How to read [`Feed::value`], which is always the signed `AttestationPayload::value`.

types.name: Gateway
docs: Protocol-authorized gateway identified by its Solana authority.
Holds endpoint metadata and activation status. Keyed by the gateway's authority key, which
signs the round dispatches tickets must carry. Gateways hold no funds: x402 payers pay the
protocol treasury directly.

types.name: InactivityEvidence
docs: A node whose availability in a finalized epoch fell below that epoch's payout floor.
Proven from the epoch's own counters; `registry_version` / `node_index` locate the node in the
current registry so it can be removed. The case hash covers only `(epoch, roster_slot)`, so a
node can be punished at most once per epoch, including after reinstatement.
Remaining accounts: `[node, epoch_state]`.

fields.name: initial_tau
docs: Ticket threshold of the two genesis epochs: a round is a ticket when the 64-bit prefix of its
ticket hash is below it, so the sampling probability is `initial_tau / 2^64`. Size it as
`2^64 * target_tickets_per_epoch / expected_rounds_per_epoch`. `u64::MAX` samples every round
(every round then costs a ticket transaction until the controller, which moves the
threshold at most 8x per epoch with a two-epoch lag, brings it down). Must be at least
`TAU_MIN`.

types.name: Node
docs: Permanent node identity and reward account; never closed or re-keyed.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version that `node_index` indexes into; also bound into the batch signature.

fields.name: batch_meta
docs: Opaque batch header bytes, covered by the signature but not interpreted on-chain.

fields.name: batch_sig_s
docs: Single-key EVM-Schnorr signature over the batch message.

types.name: Offence
docs: Node-fault offence types. Each carries a fixed [`Penalty`] — see [`OffenceKind::penalty`].

types.name: OffenceKind
docs: Fieldless offence identity stored on `PunishmentCase` and in events.

types.name: PartialTranscript
docs: One partial-signature transcript: the challenge scalars and the resulting share.
The program never recomputes `b` or `c` from a signing context — the offence is defined purely
by the equation `s*G == R1 + b*R2 + c*X`, which is why message transport and commitment lists
stay off-chain.

fields.name: b
docs: Binding factor.

fields.name: c
docs: Challenge.

fields.name: s
docs: The node's partial signature scalar.

fields.name: max_delegates
docs: Max delegates/agents an owner on this plan may provision.

fields.name: reward_per_signature
docs: Published x402 pricing input: `x402_round_base + (k + b) · reward_per_signature`.
Not read on chain; payouts come from the epoch pool.

fields.name: max_settlement_delay_seconds
docs: Max age in seconds of `timestamp` relative to cluster time at attestation
ingress, and the grace period of a superseded registry version.

fields.name: x402_round_base
docs: Published x402 pricing input; see `reward_per_signature`.

fields.name: reward_liability
docs: Sum of every `Node.claimable_rewards`.

fields.name: min_signers
docs: Current feed-admission floor; copied into each new epoch for ticket verification.

fields.name: epoch_len_seconds
docs: Length of epochs created from now on.

fields.name: ticket_grace_seconds
docs: Late-ticket window after an epoch ends, for epochs created from now on.

fields.name: target_tickets_per_epoch
docs: Ticket count per epoch the threshold controller aims for.

fields.name: min_availability_bps
docs: Payout floor relative to the network inclusion rate, in bps, for new epochs.

fields.name: min_availability_samples
docs: Selections below which the availability floor does not apply, for new epochs.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Share of all swept income kept by the protocol; the rest joins the epoch pool.

fields.name: pool_liability
docs: Sum of `pool - paid` over every epoch not yet closed.

fields.name: protocol_reserved
docs: Protocol fees and slashing proceeds held in the treasury.

types.name: PunishmentCase
docs: Permanent, on-chain record of an executed node punishment.
The PDA is seeded by `evidence_hash`, so `init` doubles as the anti-replay guard: the same
evidence can only ever be submitted once, independent of any per-offence terminal-status guard.

fields.name: registry_version
docs: Registry version the guilty bitmap indexes into.

types.name: Registry
docs: Immutable, version-addressed snapshot of the ordered node set and selection policy.
Only `nodes[..node_count]` is populated. Node addresses are stored as bytes to keep the
zero-copy layout POD-safe. `SPACE` includes the Anchor discriminator.

fields.name: active_from
docs: Inclusive creation time. A version cannot verify a round dated before it existed.

types.name: RegistryState
docs: Mutable pointer to the current immutable registry snapshot.

types.name: SchnorrSignature
docs: Aggregate Schnorr signature material.

types.name: Secp256k1KeyClaim
docs: Permanent reservation for a secp256k1 node key.

fields.name: raw_value
docs: Preimage of `attestation.payload.value` for values longer than 32 bytes. When present the
signed value must be `keccak256(raw_value)` and the feed stores it as
[`FeedValueKind::Hash`].

fields.name: coalition_key
docs: Affine sum of the signers' secp256k1 keys (`molpha_verifier::coalition_key`, or any
library's point sum over their `Node` accounts). Unsigned and untrusted: the verifier
checks it projectively against its own sum instead of inverting. A wrong key only fails
the instruction.

fields.name: max_rounds
docs: Round quota per plan snapshot. Enforced by the gateway at admission, not on chain.

types.name: TicketMarker
docs: Existence marker for a submitted ticket; blocks resubmitting the same round.
PDA: `[SEED_PREFIX, ticket_id]`. Once the round's epoch stops accepting tickets the round can
never be submitted again, so the marker becomes closable and returns its rent.

fields.name: closable_after
docs: The round's epoch ticket deadline (`end + ticket_grace`).

types.name: TicketRosterOverflow
docs: Selected nodes left uncounted because the epoch roster was full.

fields.name: gateway
docs: Gateway PDA whose authority signed the round dispatch.

fields.name: coalition_key
docs: Affine sum of the attestation's signer keys, intruders included. A verification input,
not evidence: it is left out of [`Evidence::hash`], so the case PDA derives from the
attestation alone.

fields.name: epoch_len_seconds
docs: Epoch parameters apply to epochs created after this update, never to existing ones.
